description: Qualifying surviving spouse age 50 with wages and qualified dividends: the net investment income tax uses the 250,000 joint threshold, the additional Medicare tax the 200,000 threshold.
worked:
Filing status: qualifying surviving spouse.
Taxpayer: born 1975-10-10, age 50 at the end of 2025.
Form 1040: line 1z wages 230,000; line 3a qualified dividends 30,000; line 3b ordinary dividends 30,000.
Form 1040 line 9 total income = 230,000 + 30,000 = 260,000; line 10 adjustments 0; line 11a/11b adjusted gross income = 260,000.
Line 12e standard deduction = 31,500 (married filing jointly amount, used by a qualifying surviving spouse; no line 12d box: nobody 65 or older or blind).
Schedule 1-A Part V: nobody is 65 or older at the end of the year; senior deduction 0.
Line 14 = 31,500 + 0 = 31,500; line 15 taxable income = 260,000 - 31,500 = 228,500.
Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet (Form 1040 line 16):
  line 1 = 228,500; line 2 = 30,000; line 3 = 0 (no Schedule D; Form 1040 line 7a is 0); line 4 = 30,000; line 5 = 228,500 - 30,000 = 198,500
  line 6 = 96,700; line 7 = smaller of 228,500 and 96,700 = 96,700; line 8 = smaller of 198,500 and 96,700 = 96,700; line 9 = 0 taxed at 0%
  line 10 = smaller of 228,500 and 30,000 = 30,000; line 11 = 0; line 12 = 30,000
  line 13 = 600,050; line 14 = smaller of 228,500 and 600,050 = 228,500; line 15 = 198,500 + 0 = 198,500; line 16 = 30,000; line 17 = smaller of 30,000 and 30,000 = 30,000
  line 18 = 15% x 30,000 = 4,500; line 19 = 30,000; line 20 = 30,000 - 30,000 = 0; line 21 = 20% x 0 = 0
  line 22 (tax on line 5): Tax Rate Schedule Y-1 (married filing jointly or qualifying surviving spouse) on 198,500: 10% x 23,850 = 2,385; 12% x (96,950 - 23,850) = 8,772; 22% x (198,500 - 96,950) = 22,341; total 33,498
  line 23 = 4,500 + 0 + 33,498 = 37,998
  line 24 (tax on line 1): Tax Rate Schedule Y-1 (married filing jointly or qualifying surviving spouse) on 228,500: 10% x 23,850 = 2,385; 12% x (96,950 - 23,850) = 8,772; 22% x (206,700 - 96,950) = 24,145; 24% x (228,500 - 206,700) = 5,232; total 40,534
  line 25 = smaller of 37,998 and 40,534 = 37,998 -> Form 1040 line 16 (regular tax)
Form 8960: lines 1 + 2 + 5a = 0 interest + 30,000 dividends + 0 gain = 30,000 (line 8; no deductions, line 12 = 30,000; pensions, IRA distributions and Social Security are not investment income).
  line 13 MAGI = 260,000; line 14 = 250,000 (qualifying surviving spouse); line 15 = 10,000; line 16 = smaller of 30,000 and 10,000 = 10,000 (the MAGI over the threshold is the lesser); line 17 = 3.8% x 10,000 = 380
Form 8959 Part I: line 1 Medicare wages (W-2 box 5) = line 4 = 230,000; line 5 = 200,000 (qualifying surviving spouse); line 6 = 30,000; line 7 = 0.9% x 30,000 = 270 (additional Medicare tax).
Total tax = 37,998 regular + 380 net investment income tax + 270 additional Medicare tax = 38,648.
